source("path/to/SCP-local/load_scp_local.R")
  srt <- SCP_local$RunSingleR(srt_query = srt, srt_ref = ref, ref_group = "celltype")

snippets.scp-cellqc-doublet#block0:
source("path/to/SCP-local/load_scp_local.R")
  srt <- SCP_local$RunCellQC(
    srt,
    split.by = "sample",
    db_method = "scDblFinder",
    qc_metrics = c("doublets", "outlier", "umi", "gene", "mito", "ribo"),
    UMI_threshold = 3000, gene_threshold = 1000,
    mito_threshold = 20, ribo_threshold = 50
  )
snippets.scp-de-enrichment-dynamic#block0:
source("path/to/SCP-local/load_scp_local.R")
  srt <- SCP_local$RunDEtest(srt, group_by = "celltype", test.use = "wilcox",
                             only.pos = TRUE, fc.threshold = 1.5)
  srt <- SCP_local$RunEnrichment(srt, group_by = "celltype", db = "GO_BP",
                                 species = "Homo_sapiens")
  srt <- SCP_local$RunGSEA(srt, group_by = "celltype", db = "GO_BP",
                           species = "Homo_sapiens")
snippets.scp-integration#block0:
source("path/to/SCP-local/load_scp_local.R")
  srt <- SCP_local$Integration_SCP(
    srtMerge = srt,
    batch = "sample",
    integration_method = "Harmony",
    linear_reduction_dims_use = 1:30,
    nonlinear_reduction = "umap",
    cluster_resolution = 0.6,
    seed = 11
  )
snippets.scp-standard-workflow#block0:
source("path/to/SCP-local/load_scp_local.R")
  srt <- SCP_local$Standard_SCP(
    srt,
    prefix = "Standard",
    normalization_method = "LogNormalize",
    nHVF = 2000,
    linear_reduction = "pca",
    nonlinear_reduction = "umap",
    cluster_algorithm = "louvain",
    cluster_resolution = 0.6,
    seed = 11
  )
snippets.scp-trajectory-velocity#block0:
source("path/to/SCP-local/load_scp_local.R")
  srt <- SCP_local$RunSlingshot(srt, group.by = "celltype", reduction = "UMAP")
  srt <- SCP_local$RunMonocle3(srt, reduction = "UMAP")
  srt <- SCP_local$RunPAGA(srt, group_by = "celltype",
                           linear_reduction = "PCA", nonlinear_reduction = "UMAP")
  srt <- SCP_local$RunSCVELO(srt, group_by = "celltype",
                             assay_layers = c("spliced", "unspliced"),
                             linear_reduction = "PCA", nonlinear_reduction = "UMAP")
